clock_integrity.scope: Sampled wall/monotonic consistency only; unsampled intervals are not qualified.

progress.scope: Committed HEAD byte rates between individual observation completions, not exact client-window acks. Bytes cover only declared sampled stream indices, with no extrapolation to total streams. Raft entry gaps are not commands or bytes, and last_log_index is not a commit index. Sequential node samples cannot establish an instantaneous cross-node gap. Missed peaks are possible.

drain.scope: post-client-exit observation upper bound; every replica, no per-attempt receipts

wal_diagnostics.scope: aggregate native WAL counters over whole invocation, including setup/warmup; not measure-window or all filesystem fsyncs. Ratios omitted when the pinned client does not report all-phase append counts (including seed). If final_counter_interval_captured is false, counters and ratios are lower bounds only.
